<module id="div_8bit">
    <description>A simplified radix-2 divider for 8-bit signed or unsigned integers.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">The clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst">The reset signal to initialize or reset the module.</input>
        <input id="sign">Indicates if the operation is signed (1) or unsigned (0).</input>
        <input id="dividend" width_description="[7:0]">The 8-bit input signal representing the dividend for division.</input>
        <input id="divisor" width_description="[7:0]">The 8-bit input signal representing the divisor for division.</input>
        <input id="opn_valid">A 1-bit input signal indicating that a valid operation request is present.</input>
        <input id="res_ready">A 1-bit input signal indicating that the 16-bit output result has already been acknowledged.</input>
        <output id="res_valid">A 1-bit output signal indicating the result is valid and ready.</output>
        <output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">The 16-bit output containing the remainder in the upper 8 bits and the quotient in the lower 8 bits.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="IDLE">State IDLE = 2'b00;</parameter>
        <parameter id="DIVIDE">State DIVIDE = 2'b01;</parameter>
        <parameter id="DONE">State DONE = 2'b10;</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="neg_divisor" width_description="[9:0]">The negative value of the divisor.</reg>
        <reg id="dividend_reg" width_description="[7:0]">The saved dividend.</reg>
        <reg id="divisor_reg" width_description="[7:0]">The saved divisor.</reg>
        <reg id="sr" width_description="[16:0]">Shift register for storing the dividend during division.</reg>
        <reg id="cnt" width_description="[3:0]">Counter for tracking the number of iterations performed during division.</reg>
        <reg id="start_cnt">Flag indicating the start of the division process.</reg>
        <reg id="res_valid_reg">Register to store the result validity status.</reg>
        <reg id="result_reg" width_description="[15:0]">Register to store the final result after division.</reg>
        
        <always @(posedge clk or posedge rst)>
            if (rst) begin
                // Reset all registers and flags
                neg_divisor <= 0;
                dividend_reg <= 0;
                divisor_reg <= 0;
                sr <= 0;
                cnt <= 0;
                start_cnt <= 0;
                res_valid_reg <= 0;
                result_reg <= 0;
            end else begin
                case ({sign, opn_valid})
                    2'b01: begin
                        // Signed division
                        dividend_reg <= dividend;
                        divisor_reg <= divisor;
                        sr <= {1'b0, dividend[7], dividend}; // Shift left by 1 bit
                        neg_divisor <= ~{1'b0, divisor} + 1; // Negate divisor
                        cnt <= 1;
                        start_cnt <= 1;
                    end
                    2'b11: begin
                        // Unsigned division
                        dividend_reg <= dividend;
                        divisor_reg <= divisor;
                        sr <= {1'b0, dividend[7], dividend}; // Shift left by 1 bit
                        neg_divisor <= ~{1'b0, divisor} + 1; // Negate divisor
                        cnt <= 1;
                        start_cnt <= 1;
                    end
                    default: begin
                        // No operation
                        start_cnt <= 0;
                    end
                endcase
                
                if (start_cnt && !cnt[3]) begin
                    // Perform division iteration
                    if (cnt == 8) begin
                        // Division complete
                        cnt <= 0;
                        start_cnt <= 0;
                        sr <= {SR[15:0], 1'b0};
                        result_reg <= {SR[15:8], SR[7:0]};
                    end else begin
                        // Subtract and update shift register
                        sr <= {subtraction_result[8], subtraction_result[7:0], SR[7:0]};
                        cnt <= cnt + 1;
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        
        <assign subtraction_result = sr[16:7] + neg_divisor; // Subtraction result
        <assign mux_out = (subtraction_result[8] ? sr[16:7] : subtraction_result[7:0]); // MUX output
        <assign result = result_reg; // Final result
        <assign res_valid = res_valid_reg; // Result validity flag
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>Designs a simplified radix-2 divider for 8-bit signed or unsigned integers, supporting both signed and unsigned division operations. Handles the division process, including saving inputs, initializing shift registers, performing subtraction, updating results, and managing result validity.</implementation>
</module>
